pay_detail: Not stated. We read the program page on 2026-10-10 and it says nothing about pay. Ask the program team.
name: Better Employment Outcomes (BEO) Initiative
org: City of Aurora Youth Activities and Services
what_you_do: Get matched with summer internships and research chances. The team also helps with networking and career ideas. It helps you write a resume and a cover letter.
who_can_apply: Aurora residents ages 14 to 18 who are in high school.
deadline_text: No deadline or dates are posted. After you send the interest form, the team says it will reach out as soon as possible.
how_to_apply: Check that you meet the rules, then fill out the BEO Interest Form (Google form).
notes: The page does not name the employers or say if internships pay. For city help, call 311 or 630-256-4636. The City's Summer Youth Programs page said summer 2026 programs are closed and to look for summer 2027.
